freshOnly.reason: Print-agent credentials and the receipts claim timestamp belong to the platform API only; the management-api database has no receipts or cash_registers to pair against.
Indexes the platform-only usage_events table so its nightly TTL sweep stops full-scanning; the management-api database has no usage_events to pair against.
Restaurant-scoped print dispatch and agent device health; the management-api database has no receipts, cash_registers or print_agents to pair against.
market_checkout_sessions exists only in the platform API database; the management API has no corresponding market checkout table.
Webhook ingestion and platform_webhook_logs belong to the platform API; the management API does not receive third-party delivery webhooks.
The platform API owns group-order split-bill writes; the management API has no corresponding group-order settlement workflow to pair against.
Delivery claims are part of the platform API service-crew workflow; the management API has no order-delivery execution surface.
The platform API idempotency middleware owns request reservations; management API has no corresponding idempotency_keys table.
Seat soft deletion and table QR seat management are owned by the platform API; the management API has no corresponding seats table.
Ingredient stock is owned by the platform API inventory module; the management API has no ingredient_definitions table to hang movements off.
Extends the platform-only ingredient stock ledger added in 0011; the management API has no such table.
Coupon codes are a platform-API concern; the management API database has no coupons table to pair the tenant-scoped unique indexes against.
